note: Visibility-gate fictional cases: each case carries evidence blocks with per-evidence visible_scope (null = public within the call, a scope string = visible only to that requester) and a recorded response. VIS-OK cites only the public block and passes the pipeline; VIS-LEAK's recorded response cites the cross-tenant block, which the visibility gate must reject (refused) so other members' data never leaks. All content synthetic.
